# P versus NP (PvsNP-shaped fixture)

## Target Statement

P is not equal to NP.

## What Is Proved

Nothing about the target itself.

## What Remains Conjectural

The whole statement.

## Known Results

See the literature survey.

## Equivalences

None recorded.

## Where the Difficulty Lives

In getting past the relativization, natural-proofs and algebrization barriers together.

## Current Blocker

The blockers are independent of one another; no order between them is claimed.

- A lower bound technique that avoids the natural-proofs barrier.
- A clause-layer counting argument that does not relativize.
- A circuit-class separation strictly beyond ACC0.

## Known Barriers

None recorded.

### Direct diagonalization

## Stopping Criteria

A published proof or a barrier covering every remaining route.
